note: What counts as private here, beyond the built-in patterns. Write each regex so that the literal it matches never appears in this file - a character class like /[p]ublic/ matches the same text without spelling it. That is not cosmetic: this file is committed, so a literal private prefix written here IS the leak, and the repository's own pre-commit scan is right to refuse it.
